skill.name: groove-utilities-stats
skill.description: Measures Groove workflow health through lesson graduation, daily adherence, rollup freshness, ratings, task activity, and commit counts.
skill.summary: Generate a read-only dashboard of Groove learning, adherence, and delivery metrics.
skill.author: andreadellacorte

content.value_statement: Workflow habits are difficult to evaluate without consistent metrics. This skill summarizes lesson graduation, daily adherence, task activity, and commits in a read-only dashboard.
actual_capabilities: Counts captured and graduated lessons for weekly, monthly, or all-time periods.
Calculates lesson graduation rates from local Groove memory files.
Measures daily-log coverage, business-day streaks, and rollup freshness.
Summarizes ratings with counts, averages, and a compact trend indicator.
Reports local commit counts and supported task-backend activity.
limitations: Requires a Groove project with a local .groove directory.
Requires Python 3 and may also require Git, beans, or jq.
Linear and GitHub task counts require model-assisted fallback steps.
Reports quantitative metrics without interpreting qualitative learning patterns.

use_cases.title: Review Personal Learning Habits
use_cases.description: Check whether captured lessons graduate and whether daily reflection remains consistent.

use_cases.title: Monitor Delivery Rhythm
use_cases.description: Compare task activity and commit volume with recent adherence metrics.

use_cases.title: Assess Workflow Adoption
use_cases.description: Measure whether a team member is maintaining logs, rollups, ratings, and learned records.

prompt_templates.title: Show Weekly Statistics
prompt_templates.prompt: Run Groove statistics for the last week and present the dashboard.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check of recent workflow health

prompt_templates.title: Review Monthly Progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Run Groove statistics for the last month. Highlight the reported funnel, adherence, and velocity values.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Current Indicators
prompt_templates.prompt: Run weekly Groove statistics. Identify low dashboard values without adding unsupported explanations.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Long-Term Compounding
prompt_templates.prompt: Run all-time Groove statistics, then compare totals with the current weekly dashboard. Separate measured facts from interpretation.

output_examples.input: Show my Groove statistics for this week.
output_examples.output: Weekly dashboard: 12 lessons captured, 4 graduated, 33% graduation rate, 4 of 5 daily logs, and a three-day streak.
Monthly adherence: weekly rollup fresh, monthly rollup stale, 8 ratings recorded, and an average rating of 4.1 out of 5.

output_examples.input: Report velocity when no task backend is configured.
output_examples.output: Velocity: 18 commits in the period. Task counts are omitted because no supported task backend is configured.

best_practices: Run the skill from the root of a Groove project.
Use the same period when comparing dashboards over time.
Treat missing sources as unavailable data, not as zero activity.
anti_patterns: Do not use dashboard counts as proof of work quality.
Do not request unsupported date ranges beyond week, month, or all.
Do not infer qualitative causes from quantitative results alone.

faq.question: Does this skill modify project files?
faq.answer: No. It reads local sources and prints a dashboard without writing files.

faq.question: Which periods are supported?
faq.answer: The supported periods are week, month, and all.

faq.question: What data does the lesson funnel use?
faq.answer: It counts dated captured entries and graduated markers in local Groove learned files.

faq.question: How is adherence measured?
faq.answer: It checks business-day logs, the current streak, rollup freshness, and ratings.

faq.question: Which task backends are recognized?
faq.answer: The skill recognizes beans, Linear, GitHub, and no-backend configurations.

faq.question: Why can task values appear as unavailable?
faq.answer: Required tools, configuration, or model-assisted backend access may be unavailable.
